blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite progress in vision-language models, 3D spatial reasoning from 2D images remains challenging. Text-based methods describe intermediate geometry with discrete tokens, limiting fidelity for continuous spatial relations. Continuous latents offer richer representations, but a single latent type does not explicitly separate the cues needed across spatial tasks. Decomposed spatial latents address this by representing position, direction, and global geometry separately under geometric supervision. Yet the geometry representation can still collapse toward one dominant direction, and unrestricted attention can leave the latents underused during answer learning. We introduce GeoLatent , combining Common–Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO) with routed optimization to structure the geometry states while promoting latent-mediated answer learning. CR-GEO separates shared from residual teacher geometry; routed optimization jointly trains geometry and language, temporarily directs visual answer learning through the latents, and restores full attention with geometry supervision. In controlled comparisons, CR-GEO raises geometry effective rank from 1.00 1.00 to 3.87 3.87 , while blocking latent readout at the bottleneck lowers direction accuracy from 89.1 % 89.1\% to 25.8 % 25.8\% on 128 fixed questions. After recovery, the differentiated geometry representation and latent-mediated visual route remain available alongside direct image access. GeoLatent achieves 73.0 % 73.0\% on SPAR-Bench and 72.1 % 72.1\% on SPBench, outperforming previously reported methods on both.
blocks.zh: 尽管在视觉语言模型方面取得了进展,但2D图像的3D空间推理仍然具有挑战性. 基于文字的方法用离散的符号描述中间几何,限制了连续空间关系的忠诚度. 持续的潜伏提供了更丰富的表述,但单一的潜伏类型没有明确区分空间任务所需的提示。 分解的空间潜伏物通过在几何监督下分别代表位置、方向和全球几何来解决这一问题。 然而,几何代表仍然可以向一个主要方向崩溃,不受限制的注意可能会使潜在因素在解答学习过程中得不到充分利用。 我们引入了GeoLatent(GeoLatent ) , 结合了常见的-residual几何对齐(CR-GEO)与路由优化来构建几何状态,同时促进潜在的介质解答学习. CR-GEO从残余教师几何中分离出来;路由优化联合列车几何和语言,暂时引导视觉答案学习通过潜伏,并在几何监督下恢复全注意力. 在可控比较中,CR-GEO将几何效果等级从1.00比1.00提高到3.87比3.87,同时阻断瓶颈的潜在读取将128个固定问题的方向精度从89.1%降至25.8%。 恢复后,除直接获取图像外,还有有区别的几何特征和潜在的中间视觉途径。 GeoLatent在SPAR-Bench上实现了73.0% 73.0\%,在SPAR-Bench上实现了72.1% 72.1% \%,这比以前所报告的两种方法都好。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual understanding and reasoning, yet 3D spatial reasoning remains challenging ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026d ) . Spatial reasoning tasks require models to infer geometric properties such as depth, distance, relative position, orientation, and scene layout from 2D observations. To improve these capabilities, existing studies have explored spatial instruction tuning, progressive training, and explicit 3D or 2.5D representations ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Wu et al., 2025a ) . However, when intermediate reasoning is explicitly modeled, it is still commonly expressed as text-based chain-of-thought. Continuous geometric information must then be represented through discrete language or numerical tokens, which may lose fine-grained spatial detail and make the reasoning more susceptible to language priors ( Li et al., 2026c ) .
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在视觉理解和推理方面取得了显著进展,然而3D空间推理仍然具有挑战性(张等,2025b;李等,2026d). 空间推理任务需要模型从2D观测推断几何属性,如深度,距离,相对位置,方向,以及场景布局等. 为了提高这些能力,现有研究探索了空间指示调整、渐进式培训和明确的3D或2.5D表示(Chen等人,2024年;Li等人,2026年d; Wu et al., 2025a ). 吴.. 然而,当中间推理被明确模型化时,它仍然通常被表述为基于文本的思想链. 然后,连续几何信息必须通过离散语言或数字符号来表示,这可能会失去精细的空间细节,使推理更容易受到语言前传的影响(Li等人,2026c.).

blocks.en: Continuous latent reasoning provides an alternative by representing intermediate reasoning in continuous hidden states rather than expressing every step as natural-language tokens ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026e ) . For spatial reasoning, however, these latent representations need to capture task-relevant spatial cues at different levels of granularity: some tasks require precise object positions or relative directions, whereas others depend on more global scene geometry. With a single latent type, spatial cues with different functions and levels of granularity have to share the same form of latent representation, making it difficult to accommodate the diverse demands of spatial reasoning tasks. GeoAnchor addresses this limitation by decomposing intermediate 3D spatial information into three complementary latent components: position, direction, and geometry latents, which represent object positions, relative directions, and global scene structure, respectively ( Li et al., 2026c ) . These latent components are trained with corresponding geometric supervision. However, it remains unclear whether geometric supervision alone is sufficient to yield effective latent representations and whether these latent intermediates consistently contribute to subsequent reasoning and answer prediction.
blocks.zh: 持续的潜伏推理提供了一个替代方案,在连续隐蔽状态中代表中间推理,而不是将每个步骤表示为自然语言符号(Shen等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年e)。 然而,对于空间推理来说,这些潜在的表示需要捕捉不同颗粒度级别上与任务相关的空间提示:有些任务需要精确的物体位置或相对方向,而其他任务则依赖于更多的全球场景几何. 在单一的潜在类型下,具有不同功能和颗粒度的空间提示必须具有相同的潜在代表形式,因此难以适应空间推理任务的不同需求。 GeoAnchor通过将中间三维空间信息分解成三个互补的潜在组成部分来解决这一局限性:位置、方向和几何潜质,它们分别代表物体位置、相对方向和全球场景结构(Li等人,2026c )。 这些潜在部件经过相应的几何监督培训。 然而,仍然不清楚,光靠几何监督是否足以产生有效的潜在表示,这些潜在中间体是否始终有助于随后的推理和答案预测。

blocks.en: Our analysis reveals two limitations that geometric supervision alone does not resolve. First, when the teacher geometry contains a dominant shared component, GeoAnchor’s geometry alignment objective can lead multiple geometry states to learn highly similar representations rather than capture complementary scene structure. We observe that the resulting geometry representation has an effective rank close to one, indicating substantial redundancy across its states. Second, inserting decomposed spatial latents into the reasoning trajectory does not ensure that subsequent reasoning and answer prediction actually use them. Under standard multimodal attention, downstream text and answer tokens can still directly access the original image tokens, allowing the model to answer with limited reliance on the latent intermediates. Thus, geometric supervision alone does not ensure either differentiated geometry representations or effective use of the latent intermediates during answer learning.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析表明,只有几何监督不能解决两个局限性。 第一,当教师几何包含一个占优势的共享成分时,GeoAnchor的几何对齐目标可以引导多个几何状态学习高度相似的表示而不是捕捉互补的场景结构. 我们注意到,由此产生的几何代表性具有接近一个的有效等级,表明各邦之间有大量冗余。 其次,在推理轨迹中插入已分解的空间潜质并不能确保后续推理和答案预测实际使用. 在标准的多式联运关注下,下游文本和答题符号仍然可以直接访问原始的图像符号,使模型能够以有限的依赖潜在中间体来回答. 因此,仅靠几何监督并不能确保在回答学习过程中区分几何表示或有效利用潜在的中间体。

blocks.en: Figure 1: GeoLatent addresses two limitations of decomposed latent reasoning: CR-GEO reduces redundancy among geometry states, while routed optimization encourages answer learning to use the decomposed spatial latents.
blocks.zh: 图1:GeoLatent解决了分解潜在推理的两个局限性:CR-GEO减少几何状态的冗余,而路由优化则鼓励解答学习使用分解空间潜在.

blocks.en: As summarized in Figure 1 , we introduce GeoLatent , which improves both the geometric representations learned by decomposed spatial latents and their role in subsequent spatial reasoning. Within GeoLatent, we first introduce Common–Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO) , which models the geometry shared across teacher features once at the set level and encourages different geometry states to capture complementary residual geometry. This reduces redundant encoding and yields a more differentiated global geometry representation. We further develop routed optimization : training first jointly optimizes answer generation and geometric supervision, then uses a temporary visual bottleneck to direct answer-relevant visual information through the latent intermediates, and finally restores full attention while retaining geometric supervision. This allows the model to recover flexible multimodal reasoning while preserving the spatial representations learned during routed training.
blocks.zh: 如图1所概述,我们引入了GeoLatent,它既改进了通过分解空间潜质而获得的几何表达,又改善了它们在随后空间推理中的作用。 在GeoLatent内部,我们首先引入了Common–Residual Geometry unitation(CR-GEO),它模拟了一次在设定级别上师资特征共享的几何,并鼓励不同的几何状态捕捉互补的残存几何. 这减少了冗余编码,并产生了更加区别的全球几何代表. 我们进一步发展路由优化:培训首先联合优化答案生成和几何监督,然后使用一个临时的视觉瓶颈,通过潜伏的中间体直接提供与答案相关的视觉信息,最后在保留几何监督的同时恢复全注意力. 这使该模型能够恢复灵活的多式联运推理,同时保留在路由培训中取得的空间表现。

blocks.en: Experimental results validate GeoLatent from multiple perspectives. Under identical initialization and batch order, replacing only GeoAnchor’s geometry alignment objective with CR-GEO increases the effective rank of the geometry representation from 1.00 1.00 to 3.87 3.87 . At the bottleneck stage, blocking downstream latent readout reduces accuracy on a fixed set of 128 direction questions from 89.1 % 89.1\% to 25.8 % 25.8\% , showing that routed optimization makes answer prediction strongly dependent on the latent intermediates. After full visual access is restored, the differentiated geometry representation and the latent-mediated visual route remain available alongside direct image access; removing image content still causes substantial performance degradation, indicating that the final predictions remain strongly dependent on visual evidence. Overall, GeoLatent achieves 73.0 % 73.0\% on SPAR-Bench and 72.1 % 72.1\% on SPBench, improving over the reported GeoAnchor results by 4.6 4.6 and 2.4 2.4 points, respectively.
blocks.zh: 实验结果从多个角度验证GeoLatent. 在相同的初始化和批量顺序下,仅用CR-GEO取代GeoAnchor的几何对齐目标,将几何代表的有效等级从1.001.00提高到3.873.873.87. 在瓶颈阶段,阻断下游潜在读出会降低一组固定的128个方向问题的精度,从89.1%的89.1\%降至25.8%的25.8\%,这表明路由优化使得答案的预测强烈依赖于潜在中间体. 在恢复完全的视觉访问后,除直接图像访问外,仍可使用有区别的几何表达和潜在介质的视觉途径;删除图像内容仍会造成实质性性能退化,表明最终预测仍然严重依赖于视觉证据. 总的来说,GeoLatent在SPAR-Bench上达到73.0% 73.0\%,在SPBench上达到72.1% 72.1\%,与所报告的GeoAnchor结果相比分别提高了4.6和2.42.4分.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We analyze decomposed spatial latent reasoning and identify two remaining limitations: GeoAnchor’s geometry alignment can produce highly redundant global geometry representations, while latents inserted into the reasoning trajectory can remain underused during answer learning. • We introduce GeoLatent , in which CR-GEO separates shared geometry from residual variation to learn more differentiated geometry representations, while routed optimization encourages answer-relevant visual information to pass through the latent intermediates during training. • Representation analyses, intervention experiments, and benchmark evaluations show that GeoLatent learns more differentiated geometry representations, establishes strong dependence on latent intermediates during routed training, and further improves spatial reasoning performance.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们分析已分解的空间潜在推理,并找出两个剩余的局限性: GeoAnchor的几何校正可以产生高度冗余的全球几何表示,而插入推理轨迹的潜伏物在解答学习过程中仍然可能被充分利用。 我们引入了GeoLatent(GeoLatent),其中CR-GEO将共享几何学与剩余变异区分开来,以学习更区别的几何表达,而路由优化则鼓励与答案相关的视觉信息在培训期间通过潜在的中间体. • 代表性分析、干预实验和基准评价显示,GeoLatent学习了比较有区别的几何特征,在路由训练中建立了对潜在中间体的强烈依赖,并进一步改善了空间推理性能。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Spatial reasoning in vision-language models
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉语言模型中的空间推理

blocks.en: Recent work improves spatial reasoning in VLMs mainly through spatial instruction tuning and progressive training ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026d ) , or by incorporating explicit 2.5D/3D information such as depth, point clouds, and structured spatial representations ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . These approaches provide stronger spatial supervision or geometric cues, but intermediate reasoning is still often expressed in discrete language, which can be insufficient for representing continuous spatial relations. More recently, GeoAnchor ( Li et al., 2026c ) moves beyond a uniform latent representation by decomposing 3D spatial information into complementary position, direction, and geometry latents with geometric supervision.
blocks.zh: 近期的工作主要通过空间教学调整和渐进培训(Chen等人,2024年;Cheng等人,2024年;Li等人,2026年d年),或通过纳入2.5D/3D清晰信息,如深度、点云和结构化的空间表示(Wu等人,2025年a); 张等,2025a). 这些方法提供了更强大的空间监督或几何提示,但中间推理仍然经常用离散语言表达,可能不足以代表持续的空间关系. 最近,GeoAnchor(Li等人,2026c)将3D空间信息分解成几何监督的互补位置、方向和几何潜质,从而超越了统一的潜态。

blocks.en: 2.2 Latent reasoning and visual intermediates
blocks.zh: 2.2 初级推理和视觉中间体

blocks.en:
Latent reasoning replaces verbalized intermediate steps with hidden representations. CODI ( Shen et al., 2025 ) compresses explicit chain-of-thought reasoning into a continuous latent space through self-distillation, while pause-token methods introduce additional internal computation without explicit intermediate symbols ( Goyal et al., 2024 ) . In multimodal reasoning, methods such as Mirage and LVR use latent visual intermediates tied to task-specific visual targets, while Aurora introduces predefined perception tokens for visual quantities such as depth and bounding boxes ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Bigverdi et al., 2025 ) . LIVR ( Li et al., 2026e ) instead learns latent visual tokens without explicit
intermediate supervision and uses visual bottlenecking to force task-relevant
visual information through these tokens before answer prediction. RIS ( Cui et al., 2026 ) identifies latent-trajectory collapse and answer bypass
and addresses them with spatial-semantic grounding and progressive bottlenecking. Recent
mechanistic evidence shows that latent-reasoning gains can reflect boundary
markers, formatting, or attention patterns rather than slot content alone ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Accordingly, GeoLatent evaluates both the geometric
organization of decomposed spatial latents and their use during answer learning.

blocks.en: 2.3 Representation collapse
blocks.zh: 2.3 代表权崩溃

blocks.en: Representation collapse has been widely studied in self-supervised representation learning ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Zbontar et al., 2021 ; Bardes et al., 2022 ) . Unlike the instance-agnostic latent-trajectory collapse studied in RIS ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , our redundancy arises within an explicitly supervised set of geometry states under coverage-based alignment: balanced utilization does not ensure that different states encode complementary information. GeoLatent addresses this setting with CR-GEO, representing shared geometry at the set level while encouraging individual geometry states to capture residual variation. We use effective rank to quantify the resulting representation diversity ( Roy and Vetterli, 2007 ) .
blocks.zh: 代表性崩溃在自我监督的代表性学习中被广泛研究(Caron等人,2021年;Zbontar等人,2021年;Bardes等人,2022年). 与RIS(Cui等人,2026年)中研究的实例-不可知性潜射式崩溃不同,我们的冗余出现在一套明确监督的几何状态中,这种状态以覆盖为基础:均衡利用不能确保不同的状态编码补充信息。 GeoLatent用CR-GEO处理这个设置,代表了设定级别的共享几何,同时鼓励单个几何状态捕捉剩余变异. 我们利用有效的级别来量化由此产生的代表性多样性(Roy and Vetterli, 2007)。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: GeoLatent builds on GeoAnchor’s text–latent interleaved framework with decomposed position (POS), direction (DIR), and geometry (GEO) latents ( Li et al., 2026c ) . On top of this framework, we introduce two key designs: Common–Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO) to improve the global geometry represented by the GEO latents, and routed optimization to promote the use of these latent intermediates during answer learning. Figure 2 illustrates the overall framework.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries: Decomposed Spatial Latents
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况: 已分解的空间元件

blocks.en: GeoLatent follows GeoAnchor’s text–latent interleaved framework ( Li et al., 2026c ) , where language tokens and spatial latents are generated within the same autoregressive reasoning trajectory. Each latent consists of continuous hidden states that are mapped back to the language-model input space by a latent projector, allowing them to condition subsequent generation. Separate geometry heads map the latent hidden states to their corresponding geometric target spaces.
blocks.zh: 以下为 GeoLatent GeoAnchor 的文本 - 纬度互离框架(Li et al., 2026c), 在同一自旋推理轨迹中生成语言符号和空间潜质. 每个潜伏状态都由连续隐藏状态组成,这些状态由一个潜伏的投影仪映射回语言模型输入空间,使其能为后一代设定条件. 单独的几何头将潜在的隐藏状态映射到相应的几何目标空间.

blocks.en: The decomposed latents encode complementary 3D information. POS and DIR represent local cues for object position and relative direction. Their hidden states are mean-pooled and mapped by separate linear heads to a camera-frame 3D position or unit direction vector, supervised with Smooth- ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ( Girshick, 2015 ) and cosine losses, respectively. The corresponding targets are precomputed from Depth Anything v3 camera-frame back-projection ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . GEO instead represents global scene geometry through multiple latent states projected into the VGGT alignment space and supervised against multi-scale pooled VGGT features ( Wang et al., 2025a ) . Unlike POS and DIR, an individual GEO state is not assigned a predefined physical quantity; supervision is defined over the GEO set and the global teacher geometry.

blocks.en: 3.4 Routed Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.4 路由优化

blocks.en: Geometric supervision alone does not ensure that the resulting spatial latents are used during answer learning. Under standard multimodal attention, downstream text and answer tokens can directly access image features and may therefore rely only weakly on the latent intermediates. Inspired by the visual bottlenecking strategy of LIVR ( Li et al., 2026e ) , we introduce a three-stage routed optimization schedule for decomposed spatial latents.
blocks.zh: 仅靠几何监督并不能确保在回答学习过程中利用由此产生的空间潜伏。 在标准的多式联运关注下,下游文本和答录符可以直接访问图像特征,因此可能只能微弱依赖潜在的中间体. 受LIVR(Li等人,2026e)视觉瓶颈策略的启发,我们引入了分解空间潜质的三阶段路由优化时间表.

blocks.en: Joint. We first jointly optimize next-token prediction and geometric supervision under standard multimodal attention. This allows the decomposed spatial latents to develop together with reasoning and answer generation.
blocks.zh: 联合 我们首先在标准的多式联运关注下,共同优化近距离预测和几何监督。 这使得分解的空间潜质与推理和答案生成一起发展.

blocks.en: Bottleneck. We then temporarily prevent question, intermediate-text, and answer queries from attending directly to image keys, while latent queries retain visual access. Visual information needed by subsequent reasoning and answer prediction must therefore pass through the generated spatial latents. Geometric supervision is retained during this stage to preserve their spatial representations.
blocks.zh: 博特伦克. 然后我们暂时防止提问、中间文本和回答询问直接涉及图像密钥,而潜在的询问则保留视觉访问。 因此,后续推理和答案预测所需的视觉信息必须穿过产生的空间潜伏。 在这一阶段保留几何监督,以保持它们的空间表现。

blocks.en: Recovery. Finally, we restore full visual attention while continuing geometric supervision. The model can again combine direct image access with the latent-mediated route learned during bottleneck training, while retaining the differentiated geometric representations. Detailed routing masks, stage lengths, and loss weights are provided in Appendix B.5 .
blocks.zh: 复苏。 最后,我们恢复全视的注意力,同时继续几何监督. 该模型可以再次将直接图像访问与瓶颈训练中学到的潜在媒介路线结合起来,同时保留不同的几何表示. 详细的路由口罩,舞台长度,损失重量见附录B.5.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate whether the decomposed latents are geometrically structured, used during answer learning, and visually dependent. Objective comparisons and POS/DIR decoding test representation structure; route interventions directly test latent use beyond task accuracy ( Guo et al., 2026 ) ; benchmark and image interventions evaluate task performance and visual dependence.
blocks.zh: 我们评估分解的潜质是否几何结构,在回答学习时使用,以及视线依赖。 客观比较和POS/DIR解码测试表达结构;路线干预直接测试任务精度之外的潜在用途(Guo等人,2026年);基准和图像干预评价任务性能和视觉依赖性.

blocks.en: Implementation. GeoLatent uses Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) with two hidden states for each POS/DIR latent and eight for GEO. Joint, bottleneck, and recovery run for 3,311 / 1,000 / 3,311 steps with learning rates ( 2 , 1 , 2 ) × 10 − 5 (2,1,2)\times 10^{-5} and global batch 32. The vision encoder is frozen; the merger, language model, and latent modules are trainable. Controlled runs share the checkpoint, data, optimizer, and phase lengths; the loss-only comparison additionally matches initialization and per-rank batch order.

We use 105,928 single-image samples: 100k released SPAR records ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) from ScanNet, ScanNet++, and Structured3D ( Dai et al., 2017 ; Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2020 ) , plus 5,928 single-image SpatialLadder samples ( Li et al., 2026d ) . POS/DIR targets use Depth Anything v3 camera-frame back-projection; GEO supervision uses VGGT features pooled at { 1 , 2 , 4 } \{1,2,4\} .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: GeoLatent addresses redundant GEO representations and underuse of decomposed spatial latents. CR-GEO separates shared from residual teacher geometry, while routed optimization temporarily directs visual answer learning through the latents before restoring full attention. Experiments show differentiated GEO representations, decodable image-specific POS/DIR latents, strong bottleneck-stage latent use, and a usable latent-mediated route after recovery. Image interventions further show that the recovered predictions remain tied to corresponding visual evidence rather than the ViewSpatial Person-template prior. Together, these results improve spatial reasoning while separating representation structure, latent use, and visual dependence.
blocks.zh: GeoLatent处理多余的对地观测分布图和分解空间潜伏物利用不足的问题。 CR-GEO将共享的和剩余教师几何学区分开来,而路由优化则在恢复充分关注之前临时引导视觉解答学习. 实验显示对地观测分布图的表示方式不同,可解码的图像特定POS/DIR潜伏物,强烈的瓶颈级潜伏用途,以及回收后可用的潜在媒介路线。 图像干预进一步表明,恢复的预测仍然与相应的视觉证据有关,而不是VideoSpaceal Person-template的前身。 这些结果共同改善了空间推理,同时将代表结构、潜在使用和视觉依赖分开。

blocks.en: SPAR-Bench and SPBench are in-domain with respect to the spatial reasoning sources, while ViewSpatial serves as an external cross-dataset transfer benchmark with distinct examples and partially overlapping spatial task definitions. Table 5 lists the task groups and sample counts used by the evaluation harness.
blocks.zh: 在空间推理源方面,SPAR-Bench和SPBench是内在领域,而VideSpatial则作为外部跨数据集传输基准,有明显的例子和部分重叠的空间任务定义. 表5列出了各工作组以及评价机构使用的抽样统计。

blocks.en: Table 5: Benchmark task groups and sample counts. SPAR-Bench follows the single-image subset used in GeoAnchor. ViewSpatial additionally tests transfer from camera-frame supervision to camera- and person-centered reference frames.
blocks.zh: 表5:基准工作组和抽样统计。 SPAR-Bench遵循GeoAnchor中使用的单图像子集. ViewSpaceal额外测试从相机帧监督转移到以相机和人为中心的参考帧.

blocks.en: For SPAR-Bench, multiple-choice questions are scored by exact option correctness, while numerical questions use the benchmark’s threshold-averaged accuracy over distance/depth tolerances. SPBench reports relative and absolute spatial categories. ViewSpatial reports camera-perspective and person-perspective subgroups; the main paper uses its overall average, while Appendix analyses use the four subgroups to characterize how the learned camera-frame geometry transfers across reference frames.
blocks.zh: 对SPAR-Bench来说,多重选择问题通过精确的选项正确性来打分,而数字问题则使用基准的阈值平均准确度在距离/深度容忍度上. SP Bench报告相对和绝对空间类别. ViewSpaceal reports 相机-透视和人物-透视分组;主论文使用其总体平均值,而附录分析则使用四个分组来描述所学相机-帧几何学如何跨参考框架转移.

blocks.en: We compare the final 105,928-record training mixture against every evaluated example using record IDs, normalized questions, exact input-image SHA-256, and, where available, ScanNet scene/frame identity. Table 6 separates shared domains and templates from duplicated examples. No benchmark record shares an exact input image or an image/frame–question–answer composite with training. SPAR-Bench does not expose scene/frame metadata, so no scene-disjoint claim is made for that benchmark. Its exact image and composite checks remain zero. SPBench and ViewSpatial contain 23 and 14 records from two ScanNet scenes also present in the SPAR-derived training source; removing those records changes SPBench from 72.11 72.11 to 71.74 % 71.74\% , ViewSpatial from 43.20 43.20 to 43.04 % 43.04\% , and the GeoLatent three-benchmark mean from 62.76 62.76 to 62.59 % 62.59\% . Repeated question strings in SPAR-Bench and SPBench arise on different images and reflect their templated, in-domain task definitions rather than duplicated QA examples.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了最后105 928次记录培训的混合物,并比较了每个评估的例子,使用记录身份证、常态问题、准确的输入图像SHA-256,以及现有的ScanNet场景/框架身份。 表6将共享域和模板与重复实例分开。 没有基准记录与训练共用准确的输入图像或图像/框架-问题-答案复合材料。 SPAR-Bench没有披露场景/帧元数据,因此没有对该基准进行场景-离合主张. 它的精确图像和综合检查仍然为零。 SP Bench 和 ViewSpaceal 包含来自SPAR 衍生培训源的两个 ScanNet 场景的23和14个记录;删除这些记录后, SP Bench 从 72.11 72.11 改为 71.74% 71.74% ; ViewSpaceal 从 43.20 43.20 改为 43.04% 43.04% 43.04% ; GeoLatent 三个基准标志从 62.76 62.76 改为 62.59% 62.59% 。 SPAR-Bench 和 SP Bench 中重复的问题字符串出现在不同的图像上,并反映了其模板化的内在任务定义而不是重复QA的例子。

blocks.en: Table 6: Overlap of each evaluation set with the 105,928-record training mixture. Entries count affected benchmark records. “Exact example” requires matching image or scene/frame, normalized question, and answer. A dash means the benchmark does not expose that metadata.
blocks.zh: 表6:每套评价与105 928种有记录的培训混合物重叠。 条目计数受影响的基准记录 。 “确切例子”要求匹配图像或场景/框架、正常问答。 一个破折号表示基准不会暴露该元数据.

blocks.en: B.3 Full blank- and mismatched-image interventions
blocks.zh: B.3 完全空白和不匹配的图像干预

blocks.en: For the blank condition, we replace every benchmark image with a same-size mid-gray canvas. For the mismatched condition, each image is replaced according to one fixed donor mapping with a different natural image from the same benchmark and task/answer-format group. Donors always have a different image hash; they additionally come from a different scene whenever scene metadata is available. Questions, choices, decoding configuration, and scorer are unchanged within each comparison. Trained models require a complete <answer> span, whereas the raw instruct model uses the official flexible parser because it was not trained with this tagged protocol. “Vanilla SFT” is a same-data, answer-only reference without decomposed spatial latents, adapted using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) ( r = 32 r{=}32 , α = 64 \alpha{=}64 , learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , two epochs). All runs use the complete fixed denominator.
blocks.zh: 对于空白条件,我们将每个基准图像替换为大小相同的中灰色画布. 对于不匹配的条件,每个图像按照一个固定的捐赠者映射来替换,其自然图像不同于同一个基准和任务/答题-格式组. 捐助方总是有不同的图像散列;在有场景元数据时,它们还来自不同的场景。 问题,选择,解码配置,和计分器在每次比较中都没有变化. 训练过的模型需要一个完整的 " 回答 " 跨度,而原始指示模型则使用官方的灵活解析器,因为它没有受过此标记的协议的培训。 “Vanilla SFT”是同一种数据,只回答的参考,没有分解的空间潜伏物,采用LORA(Hu等人,2022年)(r = 32 r {=}32,α = 64\alpha{=}64,学习率2×10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5},两个时代。 所有运行都使用完整的固定分母.

blocks.en: Table 7: Visual-evidence interventions. Panel (a) reports full-benchmark accuracy/score as real/blank/mismatched. Panel (b) decomposes ViewSpatial into Camera and Person aggregates. Direct recovery skips the bottleneck; SpatialLadder uses matched pixel bounds.
blocks.zh: 表7:视觉证据干预。 (a) 小组报告全基准准确性/分数为实值/空值/分数。 (b) 将ViewSpaceal分解为摄像头和Persons集合。 直接恢复跳过瓶颈;SpaceLadder使用匹配的像素边框.

blocks.en: Visual dependence is not confined to ViewSpatial. Matched no-GEO loses 25.5 / 30.2 25.5/30.2 points under blanking and 34.6 / 29.3 34.6/29.3 under mismatched images on SPAR-Bench/SPBench. The control using GeoAnchor’s GEO loss and the direct-recovery control fall from 62.28 / 61.22 % 62.28/61.22\% real-image three-benchmark means to 38.31 / 37.89 % 38.31/37.89\% when blanked and 38.69 / 37.31 % 38.69/37.31\% when mismatched. GeoLatent loses 27.0 / 28.3 27.0/28.3 points under blanking on SPAR-Bench/SPBench and 34.9 / 27.6 / 10.5 34.9/27.6/10.5 under mismatched images on SPAR-Bench/SPBench/ViewSpatial; for each benchmark, no sampled sign flip is as extreme as observed (100,000 draws; plus-one p = 1 / 100001 p{=}1/100001 ). Thus the closely scoring recovered controls remain strongly dependent on visual input; GeoLatent combines this evidence dependence with a differentiated GEO representation and the highest ViewSpatial Camera score among the evaluated models and controls.
blocks.zh: 视觉依赖不仅限于ViewSpatial. 匹配的无GEO在空白状态下损失25.5 / 30.2 25.5/30.2分,在SPAR-Bench/SP Bench上的不匹配图像下损失34.6 / 29.3 34.6/29.3分. 使用 GeoAnchor 的 GEO 损失和直接回收控制从62.28 / 61.22% 62.28/61.2+% 实景三基准值的38.31 / 37.89% 38.31/37.89+% 空白时为38.69/37.31+%。 GeoLatent在SPAR-Bench/SP Bench上的空白值下损失27.0/28.3分,在SPAR-Bench/SP Bench/ViewSpatial上的不匹配图像下损失34.9/27.6/10.5分;对于每个基准,没有标注的标志翻转值与观察到的一样极端(100 000抽取;加1页=1/10001页=1/10001页=10001页),因此,已恢复的控制值仍然严重依赖视觉输入; GeoLatent将这种证据依赖度与不同的GEO表示值和所评价模型和控制值中最高的VideSpatical照相分数结合起来。

blocks.en: SpatialLadder exhibits a different benchmark-dependent pattern: real/blank/mismatched changes only from 31.44 / 30.80 / 29.10 % 31.44/30.80/29.10\% on SPAR-Bench, but from 66.75 / 45.95 / 43.86 % 66.75/45.95/43.86\% on SPBench. On ViewSpatial it loses only 3.7 3.7 points under mismatched images overall ( 44.76 → 41.09 44.76\to 41.09 ), with the loss concentrated in Camera questions while Person accuracy remains above its real-image score.
blocks.zh: 空间辅助器显示不同基准模式:实/空/匹配 仅从SPAR-Bench上的31.44/30.80/29.10% 31.44/30.80/29.10%到SPAR-Bench上的66.75/45.95/43.86% 66.75/45.95/43.86%。 在ViewSpatial上,在整体不匹配的图像(44.76 → 41.09 44.76\to 41.09)下,它只损失3.73.7分,损失集中在镜头问题上,而人物准确度仍然高于其真象分数.

blocks.en: The reference-frame decomposition localizes ViewSpatial’s language prior. Vanilla SFT loses only 2.78 2.78 points on Person questions, while SpatialLadder, GeoAnchor, and matched no-GEO improve after blanking; no-GEO separates sharply into Camera 49.44 → 23.47 % 49.44\to 23.47\% and Person 31.88 → 44.72 % 31.88\to 44.72\% . Thus its strong in-domain accuracy is visually supported, but part of its ViewSpatial Person score remains available without the corresponding image. SpatialLadder’s Camera questions show the opposite pattern: real 38.35 38.35 versus 31.53 31.53 blank and 29.97 29.97 mismatched. In contrast, GeoLatent’s blank Person score is 24.81 % 24.81\% , effectively the four-way chance level. Its real-image strength is concentrated in Camera questions, where it reaches 53.20 % 53.20\% — 8.1 8.1 points above GeoAnchor—and falls by 24.53 24.53 points when the image is removed. Thus GeoLatent’s ViewSpatial predictions derive their useful margin from the visually grounded reference frame rather than the Person-template prior. The following audit connects this behavior to the benchmark’s question and answer distributions.
blocks.zh: 参考框架解析本地化的 ViewSpatial 语言 。 香草SFT在人的问题上只损失了2.782.78分,而SpaceLadder,GeoAnchor,并在空白后匹配无GEO改善;无GEO则急剧分离为相机49.44~23.47% 49.44\to 23.47\和Person 31.88~ 44.72% 31.88\to 44.72%. 因此,其强烈的域内精确度得到了视觉支持,但其部分VideoSparadial Person的得分仍然可用,没有相应的图像. SpaceLadder的相机问题显示了相反的模式:真实的38.35 38.35对31.53 31.53空白和29.97 29.97不匹配。 GeoLatent的空白人物得分为24.81% 24.81 % , 实际上是四向机会水平。 其真实图像强度集中在相机题材上,在镜头题材上达到53.20%的53.20\%——在GeoAnchor上方的8.1 8.1分,在图像被移除时下降24.53 24.53分. 因此,GeoLatent的VideoSpaceal预测从视网膜参考框架而不是先前的Person-template中得出了有用的比值。 以下审计将这种行为与基准的问答分布联系起来.

blocks.en: B.4 Template and answer priors in ViewSpatial
blocks.zh: B.4 在 ViewSpatial 中的模板和答案前缀

blocks.en: We audit the 20,680 spatial QA records in SpatialLadder-26K against the 4,607 ViewSpatial questions used in our single-image evaluation. SpatialLadder contains 2,253 single-image camera-relative-direction questions of the form “From the camera’s perspective, is object A to object B’s left, right, front, or back?” ViewSpatial uses surface paraphrases of the same relation-and-reference-frame contract for its 1,773 Camera–Relative-Direction questions. SpatialLadder also contains 2,162 multi-view questions of the form “standing by A and facing B, where is C?”, closely matching ViewSpatial’s scene-simulation family. The latter family is outside our 4,607-question four-task subset, but demonstrates that the two resources share a common template vocabulary and reference-frame construction.
blocks.zh: 我们对照我们单一图像评估中使用的4,607个VideoSpaceSpaceSpaceSpace问题,对SpaceLadder-26K中的20,680个空间QA记录进行审计。 SpaceLadder包含2,253个单图像相机相对方向的形式问题 " 从镜头的角度来看,是B的左、右、前或后方的对象A? " ViewSpatial在其1,773个相机-比例-指示问题中使用了同一关系和参照框架合同的表面解释。 空间 Ladder还包含着2,162个多视图问题,即“由A站立,面对B,C在哪里?” ,与VideoSpaceal的场景模拟家族紧密匹配。 后一个家族不在我们的4,607个问题四任务子集之外,但表明这两个资源共享一个通用的模板词汇和参考框架构建.

blocks.en: After lowercase and punctuation normalization, no complete question string is shared between the 20,680 SpatialLadder records and the 4,607 ViewSpatial questions. The exploitable signal is therefore a task-distribution prior rather than verbatim QA duplication. Table 8 separates answer-position balance from answer-semantics balance.
blocks.zh: 小写和标点正常化后,20,680个SpaceLadder记录和4,607个 ViewSpacetial问题之间没有完整的问题字符串共享. 因此,可以利用的信号是事先分配任务,而不是逐字分配质量评估。 表8将回答-位置平衡与回答-语义平衡分开.

blocks.en: Table 8: ViewSpatial answer priors. “Letter max” is the frequency of the most common correct option position; “semantic max” is the most frequent direction irrespective of option position.
blocks.zh: 表8:VideoSpaceal 答复前科。 “最大值”是最常见的正确选项位置的频率;“最高值”是不论选项位置如何最常见的方向。

blocks.en: The strongest prior occurs in Person–Object-Orientation: 570 of 996 gold answers are semantically “front,” although their A–D positions remain balanced. With blank images, SpatialLadder predicts “front” on 614 examples, “front-left” on 241, and “front-right” on 81, reaching 76.10 % 76.10\% on this subgroup and 74.20 % 74.20\% with mismatched images. This behavior is consistent with reliance on direction semantics and template-conditioned option structure rather than a fixed answer letter. Its overall accuracy is 43.37 % 43.37\% with blank images and 41.09 % 41.09\% with mismatched images, compared with 44.76 % 44.76\% on real images.
blocks.zh: 以往最强的答案出现在Person-Object-Orientation:996个黄金答案中,有570个答案是“最前沿的”,尽管其A-D位置仍然平衡。 在空白图像中,SpaceLadder预测了614个实例的“前方”、241个实例的“前方左”和81个实例的“前方右”,在这个分组中达到76.10%的76.10%,74.20%的74.20%的图像不匹配。 这种行为符合对方向语义和模板条件选项结构的依赖,而不是固定的回答字母. 其整体精度为43.37 % 43.37 %,空白图像为41.09% 41.09 %,不匹配图像为41.09%,而真实图像为44.76% 44.76 %.

blocks.en: GeoLatent provides an informative contrast because its training mixture includes all 5,928 SpatialLadder single-image examples, including the 2,253 camera-relative questions. Nevertheless, blanking ViewSpatial images reduces GeoLatent from 43.20 % 43.20\% to 27.13 % 27.13\% , close to the 25 % 25\% chance level. Exposure to the template family therefore does not by itself account for GeoLatent’s normal-image performance: its recovered predictions derive most of their above-chance ViewSpatial accuracy from visual evidence.
blocks.zh: GeoLatent提供了一个信息化的对比,因为其培训混合物包括所有5,928个SpaceLadder单图样例,包括2,253个相机相关问题. 尽管如此,空白的Video空间图像将GeoLatent从43.20% 43.20%减少到27.13% 27.13%,接近25% 25%的机会水平。 因此,接触模板家族本身并不能说明GeoLatent的正常图像性能:其恢复的预测从视觉证据中得出大部分高于常规的视差空间精度。

blocks.zh: B.5 培训配置

blocks.en: For the loss-only joint test, we construct one shared seed-3407 initialization after all added latent modules are instantiated, then launch both arms from those bit-identical tensors. The per-rank batch sequences, data, optimizer, learning rate, step count, attention policy, and stage-specific local/GEO supervision weights are identical; the only changed field is ℒ CR ​ - ​ GEO \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CR\text{-}GEO}} versus ℒ cov \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cov}} . The shared-init fingerprint and the first 64 batches on every rank match exactly. These are the loss-only joint rows of Table 2 . The recovered endpoints match data, phase lengths, routing schedule, and GeoLatent’s stage-specific local/GEO supervision weights, but are trained separately under different GEO objectives; they are not continuations of the shared-initialization joint pair.
blocks.zh: 对于只损失的联合测试,我们构建了一个共享的种子-3407 初始化,在所有新增的潜在模块被即时化后,再从这些位式对角发射双臂. 每个排名的批次序列,数据,优化者,学习率,步数,注意力政策,以及针对阶段的本地/GEO监管权重是相同的;唯一更改的字段是L CR - GEO\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CR\text{-}GEO}}对L cov\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cov}}. 每个等级完全匹配的共享-init指纹和前64批. 这些是表2中只损失的一行。 回收的端点匹配数据,相位长度,路由进度表,以及GeoLatent的阶段性本地/GEO监管权重,但在不同的GEO目标下分别培训;它们不是共享-初始化联合对的续作.

blocks.en: During bottleneck training, question, intermediate-text, and answer queries cannot directly attend to image keys, while the decomposed latent queries retain image access. Recovery restores full attention while continuing the corresponding local and GEO supervision. These controls isolate how routed answer learning and retained geometric supervision affect the learned latent representations.
blocks.zh: 在瓶颈训练期间,问答,中间文本,和回答询问无法直接处理图像密钥,而分解后的潜在询问保留图像访问. 恢复恢复了充分的关注,同时继续相应的地方和全球环境展望监督。 这些控制隔离了路由解答学习和保留几何监督如何影响学到的潜在表现。

blocks.en: B.6 Full objective and curriculum ablation
blocks.zh: B.6 全面目标和课程设置

blocks.zh: 表10的所有行均使用相同的105,928个样本,Qune3-VL-2B-指令基点检查站,以及初始化程序,除非另有说明.

blocks.en: Table 3 (a) reports the bottleneck endpoints in the main text. GeoLatent preserves strong in-domain spatial reasoning while operating through the decomposed latents and improves the three-benchmark mean by approximately 3.6 3.6 points over the corresponding model using GeoAnchor’s GEO loss. This end-to-end stage comparison complements the matched-initialization joint test, which isolates the GEO loss itself.
blocks.zh: 表3(a)报告了正文中的瓶颈终点。 GeoLatent在通过分解的潜伏物运行时保持了强大的域内空间推理,并利用GeoAnchor的GEO损失,将三个基准的平均值比相应的模型提高约3.63.6分。 这种端到端阶段比较是对匹配初始化联合测试的补充,它隔离了GEO损失本身.

blocks.en: Local-only recovery and recovery with local/GEO weights 0.01 / 0.05 0.01/0.05 improve over bottleneck-to-NTP recovery by 1.5 1.5 – 1.7 1.7 points, while the standard GeoLatent recovery weights 0.1 / 0.2 0.1/0.2 yield the largest gain. Token identities, projector outputs, images, and the prefix preceding each intervention are unchanged. All conditions use a fixed denominator, and mask-difference checks verify that only the intended edges change.

blocks.en: On the same frozen pairs and under the same four-dimensional additive attention-mask protocol (batch, head, query, key), the public GeoAnchor checkpoint remains at 82.03 % 82.03\% before and after the latent-readout cut. Replication across K K supports the stage-level mechanism on this frozen direction subset: once the direct visual path is closed, answers depend on the decomposed latent intermediates. On this direction subset, jointly cutting POS and DIR removes nearly all above-chance accuracy. This dependence on the latent intermediates is the targeted effect of bottleneck training.

blocks.en: The intervention changes accuracy by only 0.78 0.78 points at joint, by 63.28 63.28 points at bottleneck, and again by 0.78 0.78 points after recovery. This profile follows the joint → \rightarrow bottleneck → \rightarrow recovery sequence: bottleneck training routes image evidence through the decomposed latents during answer generation, whereas recovery restores direct image access. The intervention therefore captures stage-specific dependence on the latent intermediates induced by bottleneck training, rather than a permanent requirement after recovery.

blocks.en: We next test whether recovery preserves a usable latent-mediated visual route over each complete benchmark. All conditions use the same intervention-compatible attention path. In latent-only , non-latent queries cannot read image keys, while latent-token queries retain image access and downstream queries retain latent-token access. In neither , downstream queries additionally cannot read latent-token keys. Their paired difference therefore isolates the image → \rightarrow latent → \rightarrow downstream route without requiring it to be the model’s only route under ordinary full attention. Table 3 (b) reports the corresponding full-benchmark accuracies in the main text.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们测试回收是否保留了每个完整基准的可用潜在媒介视觉路径。 所有条件都使用相同的干预兼容的注意路径. 在潜在唯一情况下,非相对式查询不能读取图像密钥,而潜在托肯查询保留图像访问,下游查询保留潜在托肯访问. 在两种情况下,下游查询都无法读取潜在的密钥。 因此,他们的配对差异隔离了图像 \ 直截了当的潜在 \ \直截了当的下游路线 而不要求它是模型的唯一路线 在普通的充分关注。 表3(b)在正文中报告了相应的全部基准。

blocks.en: GeoLatent’s latent-only route retains 71.3 % 71.3\% , 71.1 % 71.1\% , and 77.4 % 77.4\% of its full-attention score and outperforms the corresponding neither condition by 5.31 5.31 , 3.72 3.72 , and 1.76 1.76 points on SPAR-Bench, SPBench, and ViewSpatial, with clustered 95% CIs [ 1.81 , 9.03 ] [1.81,9.03] , [ 2.16 , 5.31 ] [2.16,5.31] , and [ 0.53 , 5.98 ] [0.53,5.98] . The direct-recovery control gains approximately zero. The curriculum difference-in-differences estimates are 5.37 5.37 points (95% CI [ 1.78 , 9.10 ] [1.78,9.10] , p = 0.0313 p{=}0.0313 ), 4.06 4.06 points (95% CI [ 2.09 , 5.96 ] [2.09,5.96] , p = 0.00030 p{=}0.00030 ), and 1.78 1.78 points (95% CI [ 0.47 , 6.33 ] [0.47,6.33] , plus-one p = 1 / 20001 p{=}1/20001 ), respectively.
